headline: OKX Bitcoin Spot Volume Delta Falls To 699.0 Bitcoin From 413.2 As The 30-Day Rank Drops To 3.7
narrative: OKX spot cumulative volume delta fell to 699.0 bitcoin from 413.2 bitcoin, and the 30-day rank fell to 3.7 from 13.4. The pipe is aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume on OKX spot: a negative print is sellers hitting bids, and a positive print is buyers lifting offers. A rank of 3.7 means 3.7 percent of the past month's 24-hour windows were more negative than this one.
author: jordan
